content: Original curator paraphrase: classifier scores require calibration. Probability bins can compare predictions with observed positive-label fractions. Training and calibration rows must be separated. This lab uses its own frozen finite-bin model, not copied scikit-learn code. The 0.70 entry threshold below is an unqualified lab hypothesis, not a profitable publisher rule.
